tests.notes: Packet decoding scenarios: decode small length-prefixed packet; decode varint packet length; decode empty packet stream.

steps.notes: Decodes two fields with one-byte lengths and checks field count plus payload checksum.
Exercises multi-byte varint length parsing before consuming a longer payload.
Runs the decoder with no fields so the loop is skipped.
